findings.title: Update publication claims for the changed handbook
findings.body: The handbook is content-addressed by `publication-example-claims.json`; its existing page and prose-region hashes still describe the old bytes. The supplied coverage validator compares those hashes to the current file and will fail with `publication inline/prose example claims changed` after this edit. Regenerate/update the handbook record (and its dependent pinned claim fingerprints) with this documentation change.

overall_explanation: The baseline wording correctly aligns with the fixture, but the only submitted file change leaves the required content-addressed publication claims stale, causing documentation publication validation to fail.
